shortDescription: This module manages addition or removal of ports to or from the Fibre Channel(FC) portsets on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems.

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: fcportid
options.description: Specifies the Fibre Channel I/O port ID of the port. The value can be a decimal number 1 to the maximum number of FC I/O ports.

options.name: ignoreautozoneincapable
options.description: Specifies whether to ignore if the FC IO port is not auto zoning capable. When adding an autozone-incapable FC IO port to an autozone-enabled portset, the system rejects the command with a CMMVC1517E error. Set this parameter to C(true) to force the module to add the port to the portset despite it not being auto zoning capable. This is an optional user parameter that can be explicitly set when needed to handle autozone compatibility issues.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the FC portset.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: state
options.description: Add (C(present)) or Remove (C(absent)) the FC port ID to or from the FC portset

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
